items.answer: Teaira McCowan is from Brenham, Texas, where she was a Parade All-American at Brenham High School.

items.question: Where did Teaira McCowan play college basketball?
items.answer: Teaira McCowan played at Mississippi State from 2015 to 2019 and helped the Bulldogs reach the national championship game in 2017 and 2018. She is the NCAA Tournament's career rebounding leader with 240, was a two-time national defensive player of the year and was the SEC Player of the Year as a senior.

items.question: When was Teaira McCowan drafted?
items.answer: The Indiana Fever drafted Teaira McCowan third overall in the 2019 WNBA Draft, and she made the 2019 All-Rookie Team. Dallas acquired her in a trade before the 2022 season.
